biotools.summary: MSColoR is a software tool for modeling multi-stage disease progression and identifying genetic risk factors, specifically designed for Alzheimer’s disease studies using longitudinal neuroimaging and genetic data. It leverages a novel collaborative learning method to jointly model disease progression and associate it with genetic variations.
